note: Additional local evaluation briefs. These are not part of the official Gaddex challenge inputs and must not be special-cased.

briefs.text: 20 people in Barcelona. We want something outdoors and active, ideally competitive. Maximum €75 per person.
briefs.purpose: Multiple hard-feasible candidates; soft-preference ranking; price is a hard maximum, not the ranking objective.
briefs.expected: Team sailing regatta outranks the e-bike tour: both are under budget and outdoor/active, but sailing additionally matches competitive.

briefs.text: 12 of us in Málaga, looking for something relaxed and indoors after work. Keep it under €40 per person.
briefs.purpose: Non-mandatory supplier matching using soft tags, capacity and budget.
briefs.expected: Málaga wine tasting is the strongest natural match.

briefs.text: We have 20 people in Madrid and want a padel activity. Budget is €35 each.
18 people in Seville want to go kayaking in March, maximum €50 per person.
briefs.expected: Unfulfillable: Guadalquivir Kayak is only available April through October.
